evals.name: telehealth-booking
evals.prompt: We're designing a telehealth appointment booking system. Run a CIDER audit — I want to understand where we might be excluding users with cognitive disabilities, low digital literacy, unreliable internet, or who speak a language other than English.
evals.expected_output: CIDER audit identifying exclusion points across cognitive, digital literacy, connectivity, and language dimensions, with inclusive alternatives for each.

evals.name: voting-registration
evals.prompt: Audit an online voter registration system using CIDER. Consider users with visual impairments, users without stable housing addresses, users with limited English proficiency, and users accessing from shared public computers.
evals.expected_output: Comprehensive CIDER analysis covering accessibility, housing instability, language, and device/privacy constraints with specific inclusive design countermeasures.

evals.name: banking-onboarding
evals.prompt: Run CIDER on a mobile banking app's onboarding flow that requires: photo ID upload, selfie verification, SMS code, and linking an existing bank account. Who are we excluding?
evals.expected_output: Audit identifying exclusion of undocumented individuals, people without smartphones, those with disfigurements affecting selfie match, people without existing bank accounts, etc.
